biomarkers.name: ALK translocation (NPM1-ALK t(2;5) most common; others include TPM3-ALK, ATIC-ALK, TFG-ALK, CLTC-ALK)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Defining event. ALK IHC pattern (nuclear+cytoplasmic for NPM1-ALK; usually cytoplasmic-only for most non-NPM1 partners) may suggest fusion partner. ALK inhibitors (crizotinib; also activity reported with later-generation ALK inhibitors such as brigatinib and lorlatinib) are active in relapsed/refractory disease.

biomarkers.name: CD30
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic hallmark and therapeutic target; brentuximab vedotin + CHP is an established first-line option in systemic ALCL (ECHELON-2).

biomarkers.name: EMA, cytotoxic markers (granzyme B, perforin, TIA-1)
IPI
biomarkers.clinical_use: Risk stratification; ALK-positive ALCL generally has better outcomes than ALK-negative ALCL, particularly in younger and lower-risk patients.

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Large pleomorphic 'hallmark' cells with horseshoe-shaped or eccentric kidney-shaped nuclei and abundant cytoplasm; cohesive growth pattern; often sinusoidal/perisinusoidal infiltration in nodes
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Aggressive peripheral T-cell lymphoma; prognosis is generally favorable relative to ALK-negative ALCL, but not uniformly 'excellent' in all patients.

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: ALK-driven biology enables ALK inhibitors in relapsed/refractory disease; near-universal CD30 expression underlies brentuximab vedotin activity
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Cohesive tumour cell clusters; sinusoidal/perisinusoidal infiltration in nodes; skin, bone, soft tissue involvement

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Mature post-thymic T cells with ALK activation driving distinctive lineage biology
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Large pleomorphic 'hallmark' cells with horseshoe or kidney-shaped nuclei; CD30+ near-universal; T-cell lineage markers often variably expressed (may lose most T-cell markers  'null cell' phenotype); ALK+ (nuclear + cytoplasmic staining pattern indicates NPM1-ALK; cytoplasmic-only suggests most non-NPM1 partners)
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: ALK gene fusion (typically NPM1-ALK from t(2;5), majority of cases; less common ALK partners include TPM3, ATIC, TFG, CLTC, etc.) drives constitutive ALK kinase activity. ALK expression pattern (nuclear vs cytoplasmic) reflects fusion partner biology.
